core_obligations: Basis property: given a point and an open neighbourhood, choose a member of the cover inside that neighbourhood and then a member of the collection inside the intersection, using closure under finite intersections (proof lines 524-540)
Conclusion: this produces a member of the collection between the point and the neighbourhood, which is the defining property of a basis (proof lines 541-548)
proof_roadmap: 给定 x ∈ U（U 开），取开覆盖中成员 U_i ∋ x 且使某邻域含于 U；再由有限交封闭取集合中成员落在 x 与该邻域的交内。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a sufficient condition for a collection of open sets to be a basis: it must contain the members of an open cover up to the basis property and be closed under finite intersections (author lemma at source lines 514-522, label lemma-make-base). The proof (source lines 524-549) verifies the defining property of a basis by choosing a covering member and then a collection member inside the relevant intersection (proof lines 524-548). The pointwise construction is the content. H3.
